facts.claim: The dated holiday schedule lists the office closed and service limited to contract obligations on November 26–27 and December 25, 2026, and January 1, 2027. Do not assume a public trip operates on those dates; confirm your service with the agency.
quote: November 26, 2026 – Thanksgiving CLOSED Contract obligations only.
November 27, 2026 – Day After Thanksgiving CLOSED Contract obligations only.
December 25, 2026 – Christmas Day CLOSED Contract obligations only.
January 1, 2027 – New Year’s Day CLOSED Contract obligations only.

facts.claim: On December 24 and 31, 2026, the holiday schedule says service closes at 2:30 p.m. or after the last trip following 2:30 p.m., with no CincyLink service. Confirm the final trip for your route.
quote: December 24, 2026 – Christmas Eve Closing at 14:30 Closing at 2:30 p.m. (or last trip following 2:30 p.m.) *No Cincylink
December 31, 2026 Closing at 14:30 Closing at 2:30 p.m. (or last trip following 2:30 p.m.) *No Cincylink

quote: December 11, 2026 – Oxford Fall Service Ends Oxford Only Oxford Fall Service Ends at 7:40 p.m. Regular R3 Schedule.

facts.claim: The Oxford Thanksgiving entry is headed November 25–30, 2026, but says service resumes November 29 at 11:30 a.m. It also says service ends at 11 p.m. and uses the unexplained abbreviation “No SR.” Confirm the exact affected trips; the date range and resumption statement are not reconciled here.
facts.quote: November 25–30, 2026 – Thanksgiving Break Oxford Only Service ends at 11 p.m., No SR, Oxford service will resume November 29, 2026 at 11:30 a.m.
